lines.text: New here? In one minute, you will know exactly how to get started.
First, sign in with your email. [pause 200] You will get a six-digit code. Type it in, and you are in.
Then follow three simple steps: set up your profile, pick your plan, and invite your team.
Your dashboard shows everything in one place. Tap *New project* to begin.
That's it. You are ready. Let's build something great.
